roadmap.title: Careful Casual run
roadmap.description: Play the whole story on Casual from a new career, keeping property damage under $100,000. Buy upgrades, make combat and dunk trap unlocks, and take the achievements that add no damage.

roadmap.title: Level-select cleanup
roadmap.description: After finishing the game, use level select to finish scans, artifacts and fountains and the level tasks that break scenery, including the damage-prone ones.

roadmap.title: Property damage and Professional
roadmap.description: Farm over $3,000,000 in property damage by replaying Times Square or the Museum, then finish the last mission. Then use level select to finish the game on Professional.

achievements.description: Finish the first level, the Firehouse training.
achievements.summary: Finish the Firehouse training level.

steps.text: Play the Firehouse training level through to its end.

achievements.description: Finish the second level, at Hotel Sedgewick.
achievements.summary: Finish the level Welcome to the Hotel Sedgewick.

steps.text: Play the Hotel Sedgewick level through to its end, including the boss fight with @enemy{Pappy Sargassi}.

achievements.description: Finish the third level, in Times Square.
achievements.summary: Finish the level Panic in Times Square.

steps.text: Play the Times Square level through to its end.

achievements.description: Finish the fourth level, in the Public Library.
achievements.summary: Finish the level Checking Out the Library.

steps.text: Play the Public Library level through to its end, including the boss fight with @enemy{Azetlor, The Destroyer}.

achievements.description: Finish the fifth level, in the History Museum.
achievements.summary: Finish the level Museum of (Super)Natural History.

steps.text: Play the History Museum level through to its end, including the boss fight with @enemy{The Chairman}.

achievements.description: Finish the sixth level, a return to Hotel Sedgewick.
achievements.summary: Finish the level Return to the Sedgewick.

steps.text: Play the Return to Sedgewick level through to its end, including the boss fight with @enemy{Spiderwitch}.

achievements.description: Finish the seventh level, on Lost Island.
achievements.summary: Finish the level Lost Island Rising.

steps.text: Play the Lost Island level through to its end, including the boss fight with the @enemy{Imprisoned Juvenile Slor}.

achievements.description: Finish the last level, in Central Park Cemetery.
achievements.summary: Finish the level Central Park Cemetery.

steps.text: Play the Central Park Cemetery level through to its end, including the final fight with @enemy{Shandor, the Architect}.

achievements.description: Complete the game on 'Casual' or 'Experienced' difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the game on Casual or Experienced difficulty.

guide.context: If a Professional level-select run was done first and this did not unlock, replay the last checkpoint on Casual.

steps.text: Play on Casual or Experienced until the final mission ends.

achievements.description: Complete the game on 'Professional' difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the game on Professional difficulty.

guide.context: Level select opens after you finish the game once. Do the Casual finish first, because mixing difficulties earlier can skip that award.

steps.text: Finish the game once so level select opens.
On Professional, play the Firehouse training and the Hotel Sedgewick start until you ride the elevator up for the first time, then save and exit.

In level select, load only the boss checkpoint of Hotel Sedgewick on Professional and win it. For each later level, play its first checkpoint on Professional, then load its boss checkpoint on Professional and win it. Go in story order.
Win the final boss fight on Professional to unlock the award.

achievements.description: Slam dunk a ghost into a trap.
achievements.summary: Slam a ghost into your ghost trap with the capture stream.

guide.context: Needs the Slam Dunk Trapping upgrade.

steps.text: Buy Slam Dunk Trapping in the upgrade menu (about $18,000).
Throw out a trap and weaken a ghost until the capture stream can hold it.
Move the ghost near the trap and slam it down. It is trapped at once.

achievements.description: Trap a ghost using the Slime Tether.
achievements.summary: Trap a ghost by holding it to your trap with the Slime Tether.

guide.context: The Slime Gun is unlocked in the Public Library level.

steps.text: Wear a ghost down, then drop a trap near it.
Connect the ghost to the trap with the Slime Tether and wait until it is trapped.

achievements.description: Trap a ghost using the Stasis Stream.
achievements.summary: Trap a ghost that has been frozen by the Stasis Stream.

guide.context: The Dark Matter Generator, with the Stasis Stream, is unlocked in the Public Library level. The freeze is short, so have the trap ready.

steps.text: Weaken a ghost, then pull it away from your teammates.
Freeze it with the Stasis Stream.
Throw a trap under the frozen ghost; it drops in.
Good places to try are the @loc{American History} checkpoint in the History Museum and the @loc{Sorted Out} checkpoint in the Public Library.

achievements.description: Trap a ghost.
achievements.summary: Trap one ghost.

steps.text: In the Firehouse sub-basement, trap the training ghost.

achievements.description: Eliminate a creature.
achievements.summary: Eliminate one creature, a non-ghost enemy.

steps.text: In the Hotel Sedgewick level, shoot the @enemy{Candelabrum Crawlers} that attack in the flooded halls while you chase @enemy{Pappy Sargassi}.

achievements.description: Purchase all upgrades for the Proton Gun.
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade for the Proton Gun.

guide.context: The upgrades open once you have used the Boson Dart for the first time, in the Times Square level.

steps.text: Buy all four Proton Gun upgrades: Blast Stream Focusing for $1,500, Blast Stream Recoil Decrease for $10,000 and Boson Damage Immunity for $14,000, plus Boson Dart Supercharge, which has no price listed. The three priced ones cost $25,500 together.

achievements.description: Purchase all upgrades for the Slime Gun.
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade for the Slime Gun.

guide.context: The Slime Gun is unlocked in the Public Library level.

steps.text: Buy these Slime Gun upgrades: Slime Blower Force Increase for $3,000, Reduced Slime Consumption for $4,000, Slime Tether Duration Boost for $5,000 and Slime Tether Cost Reduction for $8,000. The total is $20,000.

achievements.displayName: We be fast! They be slow!
achievements.description: Purchase all upgrades for the Dark Matter Generator.
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade for the Dark Matter Generator.

guide.context: The Dark Matter Generator is unlocked in the Public Library level.

steps.text: Buy these Dark Matter Generator upgrades: Shock Blast Rate Increase for $11,000, Shock Blast Heat Reduction for $12,000, Stasis Stream Amplifier for $6,000 and Stasis Stream Heat Reduction for $9,000. The total is $38,000.

achievements.displayName: I Don't Want My Face Burned Off
achievements.description: Purchase all upgrades for the Meson Collider.
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade for the Meson Collider.

guide.context: The Meson Collider is unlocked in the History Museum level.

steps.text: Buy these Meson Collider upgrades: Meson Collider Penetration for $7,000, Meson Collider Acceleration for $10,000, Overload Pulse Accelerator for $8,000 and Overload Pulse Enhancer for $10,000. The total is $35,000.

achievements.description: Purchase all available equipment upgrades.
achievements.summary: Buy every equipment upgrade in the game.

guide.context: Needs the Meson Collider, from the History Museum level. All upgrades cost $154,500 together; one full run earns more than that.

steps.text: Buy every upgrade for the Proton Gun, Slime Gun, Dark Matter Generator and Meson Collider ($118,500 in total).
Buy these gear upgrades: PKE Meter Scan Improvement for $5,000, PKE Meter Recharge Booster for $8,000, Fast Trap for $5,000 and Slam Dunk Trapping for $18,000.

achievements.description: Complete the the game with more than $3,000,000 in property damage.
achievements.summary: Beat the game once your total property damage is above $3,000,000.

guide.context: Damage stays saved for the whole career, even after you die or reload, so you can farm it after the story. Check the total at Start > Statistics > Financial Records. This closes Nice Shootin', Tex! for the same career, so get that first. Ghostworld parts, the museum sewers, Lost Island and the Cemetery add no damage.

steps.text: Replay the Times Square checkpoint @loc{Hindenburg: The Musical} from level select.
Destroy every vehicle you can. The @item{Boson Dart} works best.
When nothing is left, press Start, open the options, and choose Reload Checkpoint. Repeat the last two steps until the total passes $3,000,000.
Reload the checkpoint one more time so all the damage saves.
Go to the main menu and replay the final mission, @loc{Cross the Streams!}, in Central Park Cemetery.
The @loc{American History} checkpoint in the History Museum is another good farm; smash the Civil War exhibits.

achievements.description: Complete the the game with less than $100,000 in property damage.
achievements.summary: Beat the game after causing under $100,000 in property damage.

guide.context: Damage never resets: dying, reloading and replaying all keep it. If the total passes $100,000, only a new career gets this back. Damage from the other Ghostbusters does not count. Walls, floors, ceilings and bookshelves cost nothing; furniture, pictures, vases and chandeliers do.

steps.text: Start a new career on Casual. Enemies have less health there, so you shoot less.
Buy Fast Trap, Blast Stream Recoil Decrease and Blast Stream Focusing first. When the Dark Matter Generator unlocks, buy its Shock Blast and Stasis Stream upgrades.
Shoot ghosts only when they are high above the floor, and line up so a miss hits a bare wall, floor, ceiling or bookshelf. Let the other Ghostbusters do most of the shooting.
Against small creatures, aim at the floor in front of you and let them walk up to you.
Hold off on the @item{Boson Dart} until Lost Island. The one exception is blasting an obstacle so the Ecto-1 can pass in Times Square.
Leave three scenery-breaking tasks for later: the ballroom ham, the architecture room, and the children's room door.
Times Square and the History Museum are the risky levels. Hotel Sedgewick costs a few hundred dollars when you must move the refrigerator. Lost Island and Central Park Cemetery add no damage.

achievements.description: Collect a Cursed Artifact.
achievements.summary: Collect one cursed artifact.

guide.context: Artifacts are collected by scanning them with the PKE Meter or Paragoggles.

steps.text: In Hotel Sedgewick, scan the @item{Gustav Self-Service Tray} beside the two vending machines during the scanner tutorial.

achievements.description: Collect all Cursed Artifacts.
achievements.summary: Collect all 42 cursed artifacts, 6 in each level after the Firehouse.

guide.context: Scan each artifact with the PKE Meter or Paragoggles. Each one saves the moment you collect it, so a missed one can be fetched by replaying the checkpoint from level select.

achievements.description: Obtain a 100% PKE scan on a paranormal creature.
achievements.summary: Make one 100% scan of a paranormal creature.

guide.context: The creature must be inside the smaller inner circle of the scanner when you press scan. The Spirit Guide entry updates when the scan counts.

steps.text: In Hotel Sedgewick, scan a @enemy{Bellhop Ghost} in the main lobby with the creature in the inner circle.

achievements.displayName: Back Off Man. I'm a Scientist
achievements.description: Obtain 100% PKE scans for every paranormal creature.
achievements.summary: Make a 100% scan of all 48 paranormal creatures.

guide.context: Press scan while the creature is inside the smaller inner circle of the scanner. A full scan fills every field in its Spirit Guide entry, with no "unknown". Scans save at once, so you can load a checkpoint, scan and quit. Ectoplasm, Ectoplasmic Residue, Black Slime and Black Slime Portal are not among the 48.

achievements.displayName: I'm a Ghostbuster, Not a Doctor!
achievements.description: Revive your teammates 20 times.
achievements.summary: Revive your teammates 20 times.

steps.text: Revive downed teammates during fights until you reach 20. This comes with normal play.

achievements.description: Get slimed by a charging ghost.
achievements.summary: Get slimed by a charging ghost.

steps.text: In the Firehouse training, let a training ghost slam into you.

achievements.description: Knock yourself down with your own weapon.
achievements.summary: Get knocked to the ground by your own proton pack.

guide.context: The wall method needs the Boson Dart, from the Times Square level. The Boson Damage Immunity upgrade may block it, so do this first.

steps.text: Cross your proton stream with a teammate's stream and keep holding for about 3 seconds. A special sound plays, then a dart-like shot comes back through your stream and knocks you down.
Or stand next to a wall and fire a @item{Boson Dart} at it.

achievements.description: Slide down the fire pole.
achievements.summary: Slide down a fire pole in the Firehouse.

steps.text: In the Firehouse, use either fire pole to reach the main garage.

achievements.description: Use the Slime Tether on 15 ghosts.
achievements.summary: Use the Slime Tether on ghosts 15 times.

guide.context: The Slime Gun is unlocked in the Public Library level. The same ghost counts each time.

steps.text: Fire the Slime Tether onto a ghost, then onto another surface. Repeat until you have done it 15 times.

achievements.displayName: I Looked at the Trap, Ray!
achievements.description: Recover 20 of your own full ghost traps.
achievements.summary: Retrieve 20 full ghost traps that you threw yourself.

steps.text: After each capture, walk to your trap and pick it up. Keep doing this until you reach 20.

achievements.description: Remedy a dubious food choice to make the bar mitzvah as orthodox as it can be.
achievements.summary: Destroy the boneless ham in the Hotel Sedgewick ballroom with your proton gun.

guide.context: This breaks scenery, so skip it on a low-damage run. If you miss it, replay the @loc{Rodriguez Bar Mitzvah} checkpoint.

steps.text: In the ballroom, go to the left side of the long table and disintegrate the boneless chunk of ham with the proton gun.

achievements.displayName: I Love You When You Rough-House!
achievements.description: The tidy arcitectural office could use some Proton-based humbling.
achievements.summary: Destroy all the furniture in the Times Square architecture planning room.

guide.context: This adds property damage, so skip it on a low-damage run. The room is in the @loc{Race to the Roof} checkpoint, where marshmallow minis ambush you.

steps.text: Disintegrate everything in the room, including the ceiling fans, windows and vent covers. The @item{Boson Dart} helps.
Move on to the next room. The award unlocks then.

achievements.description: The children's reading room has a story to tell, but it will take more than your eyes to see it.
achievements.summary: Follow the footprints in the Public Library children's reading room to the puppet theater.

guide.context: This level task is in the @loc{Story Hour} checkpoint. Blasting the furniture off the door adds property damage, so skip it on a low-damage run.

steps.text: Destroy the furniture that blocks one of the doors and enter the juvenile reading room.
Scan the teddy bear with the scanner or Paragoggles.
Scan the floor to see footprints. Follow them to the hopscotch markings.
Enter the puppet theater at the far end of the room.

achievements.description: Keep your ears open to learn everything you can about the Civil War.
achievements.summary: Use all 4 speakers in the History Museum's American Civil War exhibit.

guide.context: Do not leave through the exhibit exit before you finish. That starts the Ghost War and removes the speakers. If that happens, reload the @loc{American History} checkpoint.

steps.text: Use the speaker on the first glass panel as you enter the room.
After the narrow part of the room, use the second speaker, just to your left.
Use the third and fourth speakers, one at each cavalry statue. You do not have to listen to them.

achievements.displayName: I've Quit Better Jobs Than This.
achievements.description: Some ghosts had a real blowout in the Coat Room.  Clean it up?
achievements.summary: Clean all the black slime, ceiling included, from the formerly locked room off the lobby in Return to Sedgewick.

guide.context: Part of the @loc{Splitting Up} checkpoint, after the power is restored.

steps.text: Open the door in the start area, between the lobby and the outside street, that was locked before.
Clean all the black slime in the room, including the ceiling.

achievements.description: The hedge maze is a real eyesore; do some Protonic pruning.
achievements.summary: Burn every hedge in the Lost Island hedge maze.

guide.context: The maze is in the @loc{The Hedge Maze} checkpoint. This level adds no property damage.

steps.text: Shoot each hedge with the proton gun or a @item{Boson Dart} until it catches fire. Fire spreads to hedges that touch it.
Check the hedges along the walls and in the middle until the award unlocks.

achievements.description: Airborne coffins are an affront to gravity; use your Proton Pack to avenge Mother Nature!
achievements.summary: Blast a falling coffin out of the air with your proton gun.

guide.context: This is in the @loc{Airstrike} checkpoint in Central Park Cemetery.

steps.text: In the open yard with the big tree and benches, destroy any falling coffin before it lands.

achievements.description: Quench your thirst wherever possible to avoid being scared spitless.
achievements.summary: Drink from all 8 water fountains in the game.

guide.context: A drink may save only at the next checkpoint, so do not quit right after drinking. If one is missing, replay its checkpoint from level select.
